record.question: Who was the Hamas leader killed by Israeli troops on 16th October, 2024?
record.explanation: Answer C: Yahya Sinwar. Israel announced Yahya Sinwar’s death on 17 October 2024 after the 16 October operation. Reference: https://www.idf.il/en/mini-sites/hamas-israel-war-24/all-articles/yahya-sinwar-eliminated/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
